description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You use The Answer.

Two threats to the Ward at once is a contract clause you read carefully, and you can meet both.

You gain an additional reaction that lasts until the start of your next turn and can be used only for The Answer against a creature other than the one you just Answered. Two threats, two Answers; the second must be a different creature.
